data.collector-config.yaml:
processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 4096
  filter/drop_stale:
    error_mode: ignore
    metrics:
      datapoint:
        - 'IsMatch(metric.name, "^bravo_.*") and time_unix_nano < UnixNano(Now()) - Duration("10m") and attributes["service.name"] != "charlie"'
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: collector.example.com:4317
